cases.fake_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM trips
cases.question: How many trips are in the dataset?

cases.fake_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM trips
cases.question: What is the average fare amount across all trips?

cases.fake_sql: SELECT PULocationID AS pickup_location, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5
cases.question: What are the 5 most common pickup locations?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT PULocationID, count(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY n DESC, PULocationID LIMIT 5

cases.fake_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_trips FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 1
cases.question: How many trips were paid for by credit card?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 1

cases.fake_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM trips
cases.question: What is the total revenue from all trips?

cases.fake_sql: SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY day ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1
cases.question: Which day in January 2024 had the most trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', tpep_pickup_datetime)::DATE AS d, count(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.fake_sql: SELECT AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance FROM trips WHERE passenger_count >= 3
cases.question: What is the average trip distance for trips with more than 2 passengers?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT avg(trip_distance) FROM trips WHERE passenger_count > 2

cases.fake_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS jfk_trips FROM trips WHERE PULocationID IN (SELECT LocationID FROM taxi_zones WHERE Zone = 'JFK Airport')
cases.question: How many trips started at JFK Airport?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE PULocationID = 132

cases.fake_sql: SELECT AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 1
cases.question: What is the average tip amount for credit card trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT avg(tip_amount) FROM trips WHERE payment_type = 1

cases.fake_sql: SELECT z.Zone AS zone, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.LocationID = t.DOLocationID GROUP BY z.Zone ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5
cases.question: What are the top 5 drop-off zones by number of trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Zone, count(*) AS n FROM trips JOIN taxi_zones ON LocationID = DOLocationID GROUP BY Zone ORDER BY n DESC, Zone LIMIT 5

cases.fake_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_trips FROM trips WHERE epoch(tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime) > 3600
cases.question: How many trips lasted longer than 60 minutes?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE tpep_dropoff_datetime > tpep_pickup_datetime + INTERVAL 60 MINUTE

cases.fake_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1
cases.question: What is the busiest hour of the day for pickups?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT date_part('hour', tpep_pickup_datetime) AS h, count(*) AS n FROM trips GROUP BY h ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.fake_sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total FROM trips GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type
cases.question: What is the average total amount for each payment type?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT payment_type, avg(total_amount) FROM trips GROUP BY payment_type

cases.fake_sql: SELECT z.Borough AS borough, COUNT(*) AS pickups FROM trips t JOIN taxi_zones z ON z.LocationID = t.PULocationID GROUP BY z.Borough ORDER BY pickups DESC LIMIT 1
cases.question: Which borough has the most pickups?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT Borough, count(*) AS n FROM trips JOIN taxi_zones ON LocationID = PULocationID GROUP BY Borough ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.fake_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pricey_trips FROM trips WHERE fare_amount > 100
cases.question: How many trips had a fare over $100?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM trips WHERE fare_amount > 100.0

description: Fixed evaluation set for the NL-to-SQL assistant, run against the bundled January 2024 TLC sample (48,601 trips). fake_sql is what the offline FakeLLMClient answers (deliberately different in style from reference_sql); reference_sql is the hand-written ground truth. In live mode the model's own SQL replaces fake_sql. Each case is tagged with a category (aggregation/filter/join/ranking) naming the main skill the question exercises; the harness reports the pass rate per category.
